available.quote: The department may enter into a reciprocal agreement with another state under which credentials issued to electricians, electrical apprentices, electrical contractors, and electrical inspectors by either state are recognized as comparable credentials by the other state.

requirements.value: The education, experience, and examination requirements in the other state must be at least equivalent to Wisconsin's requirements; applicant must submit an application, pay applicable fee, and hold a valid comparable credential from the other state.
requirements.quote: the department may recognize credentials from the other state only if the education, experience, and examination requirements in the other state are at least equivalent to the education, experience, and examination requirements for being issued credentials under this subchapter.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Electric utility generation, transmission, and distribution work
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person employed by an electricity provider, or a subcontractor of an electricity provider, who installs, repairs, or maintains electrical wiring for equipment that is installed in the normal course of providing utility services by the electricity provider.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Telephone, signal, and communications system work by utility employees
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in installing, repairing, or maintaining electrical wiring of facilities that support telecommunications service, as defined in s. 182.017 (1g) (cq), that is provided by a telecommunications provider, as defined in s. 196.01 (8p).

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Low-voltage signaling, fire alarm, and intrusion alarm systems
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in installing, repairing, or maintaining an electronic system designed to monitor a premises for the presence of an emergency, to issue an alarm for an emergency, or to detect and summon aid for an emergency.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Manufacture and repair of electrical apparatus or equipment
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in installing electrical wiring for components of a manufactured home, as defined in s. 101.91 (2), or a manufactured building, as defined in s. 101.71 (6), while the manufactured home or the manufactured building is at or in the facility at which it is being manufactured.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Homeowner electrical work on owner-occupied residential property
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A residential property owner who installs, repairs, or maintains electrical wiring on premises that the property owner owns and occupies as a residence, unless a license or registration issued by the department is required by local ordinance.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Television and radio broadcasting system operation, maintenance, and installation
Elevator control system installation, maintenance, and repair
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in installing, repairing, or maintaining electrical wiring, apparatus, or equipment for elevators and escalators.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Diesel electric engine maintenance and repair on heavy construction equipment
Water well submersible pump motor and wiring installation
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in installing, repairing, or maintaining a pump for a well if the activity only involves installing or modifying a conductor going from the pump's junction, pull, or device box to the nearest disconnecting point and the conductor is buried with the pump.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: In-house electrical maintenance and repair by employees of commercial property owner or tenant
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in maintaining or repairing electrical wiring within an existing facility or on premises owned or leased by the person or by an entity for which the person is an agent or employee.

scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in installing, repairing, or maintaining manufactured equipment or utilization equipment, including ballasts, electric signs and luminaires, or any other manufactured system that is designed to provide a function that is not primarily electrical in nature if the installation, repair, or maintenance only involves the modification or installation of conductors that are considered part of the equipment or system under this paragraph.

scope__scope_exclusions.quote: A person engaged in installing electrical wiring within an existing industrial facility or existing manufacturing facility owned or leased by the person or by an entity for which the person is an agent or employee.
